entries.speaker: Shadow Bunny
entries.en: Would you like to exchange 50,000[n]coins for a high limit card?
Yeah, please.
No, thank you.

entries.speaker: Shadow Bunny
entries.en: Then let us go forward with the exchange.

entries.speaker: Shadow Bunny
entries.en: You don't have enough coins.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We finally have the card! Let's do our best[n]on the next floor as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I hope I was able to contribute in some[n]meaningful way. Come, let us head over[n]to the elevator.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: They're greeting us in front of the elevator?[n]This doesn't give off a welcoming vibe[n]though...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This must be due to the instigation of[n]Sae-san. We should be prepared to fight.
Let's do it.
Hold on a sec.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: What a clever trick.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We merely followed your rules.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: Hmph! I am the manager of this casino,[n]and the rules deem that I am the victor!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It appears both the Sae-san of the real[n]world and that of this world are at their[n]wit's end...

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: ...I think our guests will be leaving now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're the only one who's gonna be[n]leaving, black suit!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Things would've been so much simpler[n]if we could do this from the start!

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: ...Excuse me, sir.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: You haven't completed your registration[n]yet. Come this way.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It seems we have no choice but to do as[n]he says. Let us go.
